description: This file is a React component for a notes application, acting as a main page that manages notes, categories, search, and editing functionalities.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Loads the list of notes based on current search and category filters, updating the notes state.

methods.name: onCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and category, then refreshes the notes list and sets the new note as active.

methods.name: onDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note after confirmation and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: onSaveNote
methods.description: Saves updates to the active note based on the draft state.
